response.text: I can’t start without a topic or what you mean by “ten parts.” Please either (A) give the topic and specify the ten parts you want, or (B) allow me to choose a standard ten-part structure and proceed. If you choose B, I will use: 1) summary, 2) scope, 3) background/context, 4) stakeholders, 5) causes/drivers, 6) data/evidence, 7) impacts/consequences, 8) risks/uncertainties, 9) options/solutions, 10) recommendations. Which do you want?
